name: Regular Naturalisation (Rendes Honositas)

requirements.blocker_text: Eight years of continuous residence in Hungary immediately preceding the application.
requirements.fix_path: Accrue 8 years of continuous Hungarian residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Must be free of a criminal record under Hungarian law, with no pending Hungarian criminal proceedings, and naturalisation must not jeopardise public order or national security.
Subsistence and housing in Hungary must be secured.
Must pass a basic constitutional-knowledge exam in Hungarian, unless exempted by law or able to demonstrate Hungarian language competency in lieu of the exam.

Three years of continuous Hungarian residence, replacing the standard 8-year requirement, available to: spouses of Hungarian citizens (marriage valid 3+ years), parents of a Hungarian-citizen minor child, adults adopted by a Hungarian citizen, recognised refugees, and stateless persons.
requirements.fix_path: Accrue 3 years of continuous Hungarian residence while meeting one of the qualifying special-tie grounds.

requirements.blocker_text: Must be free of a criminal record under Hungarian law, with no pending Hungarian criminal proceedings, and naturalisation must not jeopardise public order or national security.
Subsistence and housing in Hungary must be secured.
Must pass a basic constitutional-knowledge exam in Hungarian, unless exempted by law or able to demonstrate Hungarian language competency in lieu of the exam.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 8-year or 3-year continuous Hungarian residence
Proof of secured subsistence and housing
Constitutional-knowledge exam pass or Hungarian language proof

sources.title: Nemzeti Jogtar (National Legislation Database) -- Act LV of 1993 on Hungarian Citizenship, Section 4: regular naturalisation (8-year residence) and reduced 3-year residence track for spouses/parents-of-citizen-children/adoptees/refugees/stateless persons

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Hungary's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1 from the primary legislation itself (Nemzeti Jogtar). This is Hungary's REGULAR naturalisation (rendes honositas), which REQUIRES physical residence in Hungary throughout -- distinct from the residence-free 'simplified naturalisation' mechanisms modelled separately as hu_citizenship_descent (Hungarian-ancestry ground) and hu_citizenship_marriage (10-year/5-year-plus-child marriage ground), both of which can be completed entirely via embassy application abroad with no Hungarian residence at all. The reduced-3-year track's spousal ground (3+ year marriage plus 3 years of Hungarian residence) should NOT be confused with hu_citizenship_marriage's residence-free marriage ground -- Hungary genuinely has two separate legal routes to citizenship via marriage, both real and both sourced from the same Citizenship Act, trading off marriage duration against a residence requirement.
